purpose: Source-grounded grammar presets for machine-learning paper figures; no fixed coordinates, colors or typography.

feature_map_architecture.use_when: Feature-map dimensions, channels, skip paths or concatenation carry the method claim.
source_contract: ordered states with spatial dimensions and channels
hard_checks: pooling state before channel-changing convolution is present
copied and upsampled components remain distinct
arrows enter the correct component
all size labels have a clear owner and no line through text

residual_branch_add.use_when: A shortcut, residual transformation and additive merge define the mechanism.
source_contract: fork before the first main-path operator
hard_checks: shortcut starts at the actual input
merge is addition rather than concatenation
activation placement matches the paper version
long empty spans do not distort the source composition

contrastive_multimodal_matrix.use_when: Paired image/text batches, pairwise similarity and zero-shot class synthesis share a figure.
source_contract: vector-group ports and displayed member ports
class-vector group reused by score row
hard_checks: each displayed vector is reached from its encoder
matrix is N by N with image rows and text columns
positive pairs mark the diagonal
class vectors align with corresponding scores
chosen score connects to the predicted label

graph_neighborhood_multihead.use_when: The source shows multiple independent attention heads on a graph neighborhood.
hard_checks: each source-required neighbor and self loop has every head strand
head paths terminate at node boundaries
math labels are legible in the exported PDF
multiple head arrowheads do not merge into a black block

image_to_set_prediction.use_when: A source image becomes a token sequence and parallel learned queries produce a set of predictions.
source_contract: input and output token groups with member ports
shared per-position prediction head and no-object outcomes
hard_checks: external connectors attach to visible token groups, not only one member
input tokens enter the encoder and output tokens leave it
each decoder output position reaches its prediction head
queries are parallel rather than autoregressive
raster result examples are distinguished from editable method structure
